Kit summary

DismemberBasicExclusive Lv.1
Deals 2 stages of DMG to a single enemy, the first stage deals 180% ATK Direct DMG, with a 50% chance to inflict [Silence] for 1 turn; the second stage deals 180% ATK [Internal Injury] DMG, with a 100% chance to inflict [Deep Internal Injury II] for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each stage of DMG has a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] for 2 turns.
Crazy Chainsaw Lv.1When other allies launch basic attacks or cast skills to enemies proactively, Tyrell casts Dismember to pursue and attack the enemy once. After this effect is triggered 3 times, it can only be triggered again in Tyrell's next turn. Dismember ignores [Shield] and each layer of [Internal Injury] owned by the target increases its DMG dealt by 10%.
Bloodthirst StranglingActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 3 stages of 140% ATK [Internal Injury] DMG each to all enemies. The lower the target's HP, the higher the DMG dealt, up to 100% of the original.
Crazy Chainsaw Lv.2When any enemy has no less than 5 layers of [Internal Injury], Tyrell enters [Hyper] status for 2 turns, during which increases ATK by 40%. When she enters [Hyper] status again, refreshes the duration. When Tyrell is under [Resonance Enhancement] status, each stage of Bloodthirst Strangling, Vortex of Death, and Vortex of Death · Resonance has a 50% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Internal Injury] for 2 turns.
Predator's EuphoriaPassiveExclusive Lv.3
Max Limit of Resonance Enhancement: 20. Tyrell has 16 Resonance Points at the beginning of each wave. When allies try inflicting Control effects on enemies, Tyrell gains 1 Resonance Point. When Resonance Points reach the max limit, Tyrell enters [Resonance Enhancement] status for 3 turns and cleanses all Control effects from other allies who are under [Resonance Enhancement] status and have the [Control] tag, then grants them [Electricity Overload]: When inflicting a Control effect next time, there is a 50% fixed chance to extend the duration of this effect by 1 turn. When Tyrell is under [Resonance Enhancement] status: 1. Replaces Vortex of Death with Vortex of Death · Resonance and resets its CD. 2. After being attacked by any basic attack or skill (excluding pursue-and-attacks and counterattacks), casts Dismember to counterattack the attacker once. Tyrell cannot gain [Counterattack]. 3. Can gain Resonance Points. When entering [Resonance Enhancement] status for the first time in each wave, cleanses all Control effects from self and acts for 1 turn immediately.
Crazy Chainsaw Lv.3At the beginning of each wave, for every 1 ally with the [Control] tag, reduces all enemies' SPD by 40 permanently and reduces all enemies' Effect Hit by 40% for 1 turn. If there are 5 allies with the [Control] tag, grants all allies [Insulation] (immune to the Control effect next time).
